user.description: Pick a sunset lamp that Home Assistant has discovered, or type the Bluetooth address of one.

bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name} ({address})?

error.invalid_address: This is not a valid Bluetooth address. Use the form AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.

abort.already_in_progress: Setup of this lamp is already in progress.

entry_not_found.message: No MeRGBW lamp with config entry ID {entry_id}.

send_raw.name: Send raw frame
send_raw.description: Sends a raw protocol frame to a lamp and optionally returns what the lamp sends back. Meant for working out the protocol. Does not update the light's state.

config_entry_id.name: Lamp
config_entry_id.description: The lamp to send the frame to.

frame.name: Frame
frame.description: The bytes to send, hex encoded. Spaces and colons are ignored.

add_checksum.name: Add checksum
add_checksum.description: Append the checksum byte to the frame before sending it.

listen.name: Listen
listen.description: When a response is requested, how long to collect notifications from the lamp.
